title: Improve conditional kappa beyond T488 with a T385 combined-clock allocation
body:
This combines the retained T37/T8/T16 chronology with another T16 block and the unchanged PR3734 staged-helper544 supplier. Five interleaved copies of the resulting 77-replica clock yield a literal T385 construction.

Conditional **κ = 0.001730578437266246818740 − 10^-46 − 10^-70** improves on our just-published [PR3795](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3795) by **0.000000065515946789182046**, and on PR3734 by 0.000000130077058611357000. Its 1,413,720 helper roles and 345,469 physical families also use less stock than PR3795’s 437,757 families.

Only `research/staged544-t385/` is added. The fixed integer witness and solver-free reproduction are included; private optimization tooling is not.

Validation passed: all seven original source-bound admission stages and final isolated release; independent full literal-owner audit with three corruption controls; exact rational root bracket; both regenerated outer ledgers; registered package replay. The independent reconstruction reproduces all 30,983,204 decompressed allocation bytes exactly. Exact source pins preserve PR3734’s supplier and the retained clock provenance. The package additionally checks a strict rational gain over PR3795’s committed complete-release endpoint.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/staged544-t385
```

The bounded replay authenticates stored complete-admission evidence and regenerates owner/aggregate/arithmetic checks. The opt-in `full_replay.py` reruns the underlying changed-allocation admission with explicitly source-bound reuse of unchanged native suppliers and retained ancestry. The new packaging wrapper itself has not been run end-to-end; no no-reuse cold replay is claimed.

Inherited all-size/compiler, mutable-source/hosting, precision/tape/recovery, analytic and BIT assumptions remain. The selected repository result is unchanged. This is neither an unconditional multiplication theorem nor a global geometry/packing optimum claim.

Credit dataisfire for PR3734 and its supplier ancestry, the retained T37/T8/T16 contributors, PR3638’s integral-network machinery, and all native/owner/outer authors in the source notices. New packing and proof adaptation by hexapode with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human or formal-kernel review claimed.
